2126078859271369064.en_summary: Elon Musk announced he will gift one @SpaceX share to each of the ~70 million children in America every year. At SpaceX’s current share price, this amounts to over $9 billion in gifts annually. If SpaceX’s stock price rises, the value of those gifts will increase significantly. This is described as the largest gifting pledge in history. (Quoted @elonmusk: I will be donating another share of SpaceX to all kids in America every year.)
2126078859271369064.zh_summary: 埃隆·馬斯克宣布，他將每年向美國約7000萬名兒童每人贈送一股@SpaceX股票。以SpaceX目前的股價計算，這相當於每年超過90億美元的贈禮。如果SpaceX股價上漲，這些贈禮的價值將大幅增加。這被描述為史上最大的贈予承諾。（引用@elonmusk：我將每年再向美國所有兒童捐贈一股SpaceX股票。）
